content.description: Template content keyed by channel. Replaced as a whole on update, not merged.

body.description: Notification body text. Supports Liquid templating. Required in `content` for push-type templates.

channels.description: IDs of the project's Firebase and APNs integrations to send through. Each person gets the notification on every device they registered with one of these apps.

data.description: Custom key-value data delivered to the app. Values are strings and support Liquid templating.

image.description: URL of an image to show in the notification. Supports Liquid templating.

link.description: Where a tap should take the person, such as myapp://orders/123 or a web URL. Sent to the app as the "link" key in the custom data. Supports Liquid templating.

title.description: Notification title. Supports Liquid templating, such as {{ variables.name }}. Required in `content` for push-type templates.

push.description: Push notification content, for push-type templates. Replaced as a whole on update — send the complete object.

templating.description:
Templating language for the email content. Always 'liquid' — Liquid tags pass through verbatim.

* `liquid` - liquid

deleted.description: Soft-delete flag. Set true to remove the template from the library.

description.description: What the template is for and when to use it.

message_category.description: Message category ID to file the template under. Must belong to the same project.

name.description: Human-readable template name shown in the library.

tags.description: Tags for organizing templates, for example by team or use case. Tags are shared with the rest of the project. Omit to keep the current tags, send an empty list to remove them all.
